$files = Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -File -Filter *.go; $total = 0; foreach ($f in $files) { $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($f.FullName); $n = 0; foreach ($b in $bytes) { if ($b -eq 10) { $n++ } }; if ($bytes.Length -gt 0 -and $bytes[$bytes.Length-1] -ne 10) { $n++ }; $total += $n }; [pscustomobject]@{ files = $files.Count; lines = $total } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

$f = Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -File -Filter *.go; $lines = 0; foreach ($x in $f) { $c = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($x.FullName); if ($c.Length -gt 0) { $lines += ([regex]::Matches($c, "`n")).Count; if (-not $c.EndsWith("`n")) { $lines += 1 } } }; [pscustomobject]@{files=$f.Count; lines=$lines} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
